snippet.title: With Eyes Closed TrailerEN2
snippet.description:
This is the trailer for the game With Eyes Closed.
With Eyes Closed is a thriller in the adult visual novel genre. It concentrates on storytelling, realistic characters, and letting players control the development of the story. The game also features plenty of hot scenes that are interwoven into the storyline.
You can get more info here:
Patreon - https://www.patreon.com/kergames/about
Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2492780/With_Eyes_Closed__Season_1/
